notes.title: Update 1/25/2019
notes.content:
Hello Everyone.

I just uploaded a new build of the Endless Empty. This update includes more balanced bosses, items, the ability to sell things in the tranquility rooms as well as a few more minor fixes. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/ca74960677b92a255abc140b5b245979c48bf218.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/77b3c91456ccc687eb1c5ad04aac876e26e91fc0.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/1a2109ed9fdb19d0576bd42911f63bc18602111c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/1435947f96ae1b59e9867cc28a9acfb426df9fdb.png[/img][/url]

Thanks to your purchases and the help of my friends over in 1 of 1 gaming, the Endless Empty has now raised over $1000 for the Trevor Project.

I really appreciate all the messages, fan arts, streams and youtube coverage everyone has provided for this game. If you haven't done so already I would be infinitely grateful if you dropped a review here on steam, as it helps the game's visibility on the platform.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/4375b7e28c88236c6b767d5408b271112b0d46c5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/6c6ce3648e44769f83acc1dc18fa9198397753e2.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/822430a6dc8091ed60e84004a9a6bc02ae18ebf9.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33724360/da6770843b53adaa838aba42e4a348228ffc8eda.png[/img][/url]

And as a final update: at this moment I'm in the early stages of putting together my second game project and hope to be able to share information on that real soon.

As always you can contact me at the following places.

https://twitter.com/ErikSheader

https://www.facebook.com/SugarySweetMachines/

https://www.instagram.com/Erik_Sheader/?hl=en
